start.card:
Imagine counting out loud, one number every second, without stopping.
A million is 1,000,000. A billion is 1,000,000,000.
How long would it take to count to a billion? Pick your guess below.
start.title: Counting to a billion

afterGuess.card:
You guessed "About 2 weeks". Let's find out by counting.
First, a million. Each box on the top timeline is one day of counting (86,400 numbers). Press "Count one more day" until you pass 1,000,000.
afterGuess.title: Counting to a billion
